summary: First full pass on EPOHTECH microsite. All backend endpoints (POST /api/epoh/enquiry, GET /api/admin/epoh-enquiries) verified via pytest with data-persistence and auth checks. Full Playwright walkthrough of /epohtech home, services, programs, about, contact + mobile drawer executed successfully. Anvaya chrome isolation, back-link, deep-link interest preselection, consent-gated submit, and success screen all work.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1438 lines — consider splitting by domain (epoh, insights, ventures, admin, auth) into routers/*.py for maintainability.
POST /api/epoh/enquiry silently accepts consent=false; consider server-side rejection to match UI gating in case client is bypassed.
Enquiry emails are fired via asyncio.create_task with no failure logging — a Resend outage would silently drop owner notification.
test_credentials: Admin session minted in test_database.user_sessions for tulasi.reddy@theepoh.com per /app/auth_testing.md pattern.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 epoh_enquiries doc from pytest ('QA Tester Epoh') and 1 from Playwright UI ('QA Tester Epoh UI', delivered@resend.dev).
context_for_next_testing_agent: EPOHTECH microsite is stable end-to-end. Test artefacts prefixed with 'QA Tester Epoh' in db.epoh_enquiries can be cleaned via db.epoh_enquiries.deleteMany({name: /^QA Tester Epoh/}). Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_epoh.py for regression.
